name: use-hotkeys
title: Use Hotkeys
description: Binds keyboard shortcuts ("mod+k", "shift+?", "g i") to handlers on the page or on one element, by the key's place for letters so they work on keyboards of every script, left alone while typing in a field; and formats a shortcut for showing ("⌘K" on Apple, "Ctrl+K" elsewhere).

meta.when: Shortcuts for frequent actions: opening command, saving, moving between items. Show each one where its action is (kbd, a menu's shortcut slot) and keep a list of them. Do not take keys a screen reader or the browser uses (single letters without a modifier only inside a focused widget; never Tab or the arrows on the page).
